plainText:
The Truth and Island Kahuna Hapu (Japanese: 誕生！！しまクイーンハプウ！ Birth!! !) is the 22nd chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
 
==Major events==
After defeating , Hapu receives a Sparkling Stone from , officially making her the next island kahuna of Poni Island.
gives Tapu Fini a Mirage Berry.
Professor Kukui, Molayne, Acerola, Sophocles, and Gladion fight to prevent it from reaching Hokulani Observatory.
In order to protect Lillie, Gladion's evolves into a and defeats Guzzlord.
Gladion and Lillie reveal that they're siblings and the children of Lusamine.
Lillie reveals she is in possession of the Sun Flute.
Gladion and Lillie decide to go to the Poni Altar.
Faba and a group of s head to Vast Poni Canyon.
